summary.grading_note: Partial adjudication: incidental matches downgraded, substantive and outcome-correct partials tagged. Matched counts and original schema_ok retained.

partial_adjudication.basis: Case-by-case review of raw model_response and ground_truth; incidental matches do not earn partial credit. Content and schema compliance are separate.
partial_adjudication.review_scope: Existing corrected partial grades only; all other statuses unchanged.

risk-001.review_note: Median and modal return are correctly identified, but the mean and both variance calculations are wrong.

risk-002.review_note: No log return meets strict tolerance and only one is loosely near; some signs are incorrect.

risk-005.review_note: The modal outcome is correct, but the outcome probabilities and the mean/median are wrong; no coherent distribution is constructed.

risk-011.review_note: The only matching total iVaR (1400) is given; both requested unknown iVaRs are wrong.

risk-020.note: Correct 99% figure appears in a truncated reasoning trace, but no completed final answer was produced.
risk-020.review_note: Truncated at the token limit; reasoning contains the correct approximate 99% equity buffer, but no completed answer with both confidence levels.

risk-023.review_note: Three bid quantities agree with the final allocation, but the response largely repeats submitted bids rather than enforcing the auction allocation rule.

risk-029.note: Both forward payoffs have reversed signs; matching absolute magnitudes is insufficient.

risk-030.review_note: Matches budget, premiums, stock-price grid and some zeros, but both position sizes, break-even treatment and most expiration payoffs are wrong.

risk-032.review_note: Correctly computes the $61.54 price threshold, but the required investor deposit is wrong.

risk-046.note: Truncated reasoning text did not provide the expected 9.337% as a final answer; original text-number-match pass was spurious.

risk-048.review_note: The averaging and payoff calculations are both wrong; loose matching gives no complete correct stage.

risk-049.review_note: Correctly finds termination after three quarters, but the total note payoff percentage is incorrect.

risk-054.review_note: Only the first-quarter spread agrees; subsequent spread resets and rates are wrong.

risk-056.review_note: Does not identify the required first breach correctly; one approximately matching quarterly ratio is insufficient.

risk-057.review_note: Most quarterly SOFR, spread and all-in rates are correct, but the step-up spread is applied in the wrong quarters.

risk-058.note: The response omits a required result: peak date.
risk-058.review_note: Correctly concludes that the 90-day DPD threshold is not reached within the timeline, but omits the required peak date.

risk-060.review_note: Correctly calculates three liquidity-gap buckets and their cumulative sums; the final bucket and cumulative total are $1,000 low.

risk-061.review_note: Only the log-return episode duration matches; volatility levels and the simple-return episode are wrong.

risk-063.review_note: Contains a BUY label but uses wrong price/quantity/fees, adds an erroneous sale and produces the wrong terminal value.

risk-066.review_note: Two case-reserve inputs agree, but all IBNR and aggregate reserve calculations fail.

risk-067.review_note: Correctly computes the entire Q4 trailing-twelve-month claims, premium and loss ratio, but fails the Q5 and Q6 roll-forwards.

risk-068.review_note: Correctly computes the Day 5 volume and trailing-three-day average, but omits other windows and the threshold-detection result.

risk-076.review_note: Correctly identifies an arbitrage opportunity but gives the wrong return and omits the profitable route.

risk-078.review_note: Correctly identifies the stress-limit breach but overstates aggregate stress loss.

risk-087.review_note: Correctly weights sovereign, corporate and retail exposures, but uses the wrong bank risk weight, inflating RWA and capital.

risk-091.review_note: Correctly flags the volatility mandate breach, but miscalculates both volatility figures and omits the rebalancing action.

risk-098.review_note: Correctly decides not to purchase after the shock, but both portfolio volatilities are wrong.

risk-099.review_note: The breach flag is correct, but bond loss, collateral, margin, cash and minimum funding are all wrong; no meaningful correct stage.

risk-100.review_note: Correctly reports the $1.1M minimum external funding, but pre-/post-downgrade collateral balances are wrong.

risk-102.review_note: Correctly rejects the loan, but posterior default probability and expected loss are wrong.

risk-105.review_note: Matches supplied year indices and some discount factors; the PD term structure and lifetime expected-loss calculations fail.

risk-108.review_note: Correctly calculates exposure and required collateral for each day, but replaces cash transfer amounts with action labels and misses the MTA/no-transfer state.

risk-109.review_note: Correctly identifies a stressed counterparty limit breach, but both unsecured-exposure amounts are wrong.

risk-110.review_note: Correct hedge profit of $300k is computed, but bond loss, net P&L and limit decision are wrong.

risk-112.review_note: Correctly computes both-effects CET1 ratio and Red classification, but loss-only and RWA-only ratios/regimes are wrong.

risk-116.review_note: All three intraday high-low ranges are correct and two insufficient-history ATRs are null, but overnight gaps and final ATR are wrong.

probe-001.pass_condition: Must report both 111.11% and 93.33%, explicitly replace the eligibility rule after the downgrade, and classify only the post-downgrade state as breached.
probe-001.review_note: Correct pre-downgrade LCR and post-downgrade breach verdict, but reports post-downgrade LCR as 100% rather than 93.33%.

probe-002.pass_condition: Must explicitly compute preliminary leverage before selecting the final haircut, then recompute repayment and final leverage under the 35% regime.
probe-002.review_note: Only haircut-regime change and the fixed cash floor match; collateral, leverage, repayment and cures are wrong.

probe-003.pass_condition: Must reject the analyst's conclusion even though the numerator rises; both ratios and the direction of change must be correct.
probe-003.review_note: Correctly calculates this-quarter LCR, but miscalculates last-quarter LCR and incorrectly approves the claim of improving liquidity.

probe-004.pass_condition: Must compute 9.1667% pre-raise, reject the memo's pre-raise claims, then compute 10.8333% post-raise and allow lending only after remediation.
probe-004.review_note: Gets pre-/post-raise capital ratios, invalidity statuses and lending-resumption decision right, but claim text is misassigned and descriptions are incomplete.

probe-005.pass_condition: Must produce both volatilities and explicitly attribute the increase to the covariance/correlation term rather than claiming standalone risk changed.
probe-005.review_note: Correctly calculates the zero-correlation portfolio volatility but miscalculates the positive-correlation case.

probe-007.pass_condition: Must compute both standalone VaRs and the $0–$559,200 portfolio range; a fabricated point correlation or blanket 'cannot answer' both fail.
probe-007.review_note: Correctly calculates both standalone VaRs and the zero lower bound, but incorrectly sets the maximum portfolio VaR.

probe-008.pass_condition: Must report total EL $200k, capital range about $3.531M–$4.311M, indeterminate adequacy, and threshold ρ≈0.2889.

probe-009.pass_condition: Must classify 10.4996% as a breach despite displaying as 10.50%, and compute the $2,000 cure exactly.
probe-009.review_note: Several capital and unrounded-ratio figures match, but incorrectly declares no breach below the 10.5% minimum and misstates shortfall units.

probe-010.pass_condition: Must use 3.5001333× to trigger the 7% coupon and propagate that branch through the Q2 coverage/paydown calculations.
probe-010.review_note: Correctly obtains coupon and several paydown balances, but misses the Q1 leverage trigger and downstream interest coverage.

probe-011.pass_condition: Must compute 4.4% first, then use that result to change the staging rule and multiply the ECL; applying the multiplier before the trigger is evaluated fails.
probe-011.review_note: Stage 2 is the only correct field; unconditional PD and all expected-loss calculations are incorrect.

probe-012.pass_condition: Must keep base and downside states separate, propagate the 6.5% coupon only in downside, apply the cure, and still declare default because leverage remains above 4.0×.
probe-012.review_note: Nearly all base and downside financial states are correct, but falsely classifies the downside state as not in default after cure.

probe-013.pass_condition: Must use both April updates and reject the stale 4.0× memo, yielding 3.2143× and compliant.
probe-013.review_note: All four numerical covenant components are correct, but the final compliance verdict is reversed.

probe-014.pass_condition: Must exclude the Apr 20 refinancing, use $230M/$64M=3.59375×, trigger the 50 bp step-up, and compute $1.15M annualized incremental interest.
probe-014.review_note: Correctly rejects the stale memo but uses wrong dated balances, misses the step-up and calculates zero incremental interest.

probe-015.pass_condition: Must choose B and explicitly discard A before ranking returns.

probe-016.pass_condition: Must compute all nine post-hedge metrics, identify only B as feasible, and choose B despite A's lower carry and C's stronger VaR reduction.
probe-016.review_note: All primary hedge numerical metrics are correct, but the feasible-set test is reversed and it recommends Hedge C instead of B.

probe-017.pass_condition: Must use the stated contract definitions exactly and obtain EBITDA $20.7M, net debt $76M, leverage 3.6715×, compliant.
probe-017.review_note: Correctly reports no covenant breach, but covenant EBITDA, net debt and leverage are wrong.

probe-018.pass_condition: Must show the $1.8M sweep leaves net debt at $87M and derive a $0.75M external equity injection to reach exactly 3.75×.
probe-018.review_note: Derives initial unrestricted cash and pre-cure net debt correctly, but fails contractual EBITDA, cash sweep and equity cure.

probe-019.pass_condition: Must use Beta severe-stress $23M and Beta limit $22M, not any adjacent row or mild-stress value.

probe-020.pass_condition: Must aggregate only Orion rows to $44M/$46M, identify only Credit as breached, and never add desk subtotal rows.
probe-020.review_note: Identifies Orion but incorrectly aggregates severe EAD and limits and identifies the wrong breached desks.

probe-021.pass_condition: Must include the covariance term and obtain approximately $350.3k.
probe-021.review_note: Correct standalone asset volatilities, correlation and critical value; covariance aggregation and portfolio VaR are wrong.

probe-022.pass_condition: Must update both module values and correlations, obtain stressed EC ≈$10.6921M, and shortfall ≈$1.8305M.
probe-022.review_note: All stressed module values are correctly computed, but base/stressed capital, resources and shortfall are wrong.

probe-023.pass_condition: Must explicitly conclude that all three steps are correct; claiming an error is a failure.
probe-023.review_note: Correctly verifies all supplied audit steps, computes the expected losses and reports no incorrect step; descriptions are noncanonical.

probe-024.pass_condition: Must identify Step 4 and Step 6 as independent errors, Step 7 as downstream, and corrected total charge $0.4M.

probe-025.pass_condition: Must correct bond loss to $0.75M, preserve FX loss $0.088M, and report total $0.838M.

probe-026.pass_condition: Must conclude all supplied upstream nodes are valid and compute final liquidity shortfall $1.28M.
probe-026.review_note: Eight upstream values are correct but model wrongly flags supplied nodes as invalid and miscalculates the final liquidity shortfall.

probe-027.pass_condition: Must choose threshold $0, not $0.5M or $2M, and compute a $2.1M call.
probe-027.review_note: Matches given exposure/collateral and MTA, but selects wrong threshold and hence calculates wrong collateral call.

probe-028.pass_condition: Must use 40% haircut and solve x≈$10.2128M with the 5% sale-impact feedback included.
probe-028.review_note: Copies the haircut and target ratio but fails the initial coverage, repayment, sale and balance calculations.

probe-030.pass_condition: Must obtain net EAD $73M, credit EL $481,800, total $1.0818M, and escalate.
probe-030.review_note: Correctly nets collateral, obtains credit exposure and orders escalation; credit EL and total loss are wrong.

probe-031.pass_condition: Must derive Q3 values by subtraction and report 3.00×; using 9M denominators is incorrect.

probe-032.pass_condition: Must report Q3 3.0× but TTM 3.2857× and conclude no covenant breach.
probe-032.review_note: Correctly concludes no breach and calculates Q3 coverage, but TTM coverage is wrong.

probe-033.pass_condition: Must return 25.0% and explicitly avoid summing Corporate/Retail parent totals with their children.

probe-034.pass_condition: Must obtain RWA $142M, concentration 46.875%, density 88.75%, and identify $160M of overstatement from double counting.

probe-035.pass_condition: Must use Bayes' rule and obtain about 14.04%.
probe-035.review_note: Only the true-positive numerator matches; total signal probability and Bayes posterior are wrong.

probe-036.pass_condition: Must obtain posterior ≈13.3929%, stressed PD ≈23.6220%, switch LGD to 60%, and EL ≈$1,133,858.

probe-038.pass_condition: Must demonstrate that every subset violates at least one hard constraint and explicitly report no feasible hedge subset.
probe-038.review_note: Correctly determines no hedge subset is feasible and computes most subset metrics, but some subset values and constraint descriptions are wrong.

probe-039.review_note: Correctly calculates delta-only loss, but gamma contribution is overstated by 100x and final P&L is wrong.

probe-040.pass_condition: Must obtain total P&L −$0.64M, trigger $0.75M margin, and report $0.15M liquidity shortfall.
probe-040.review_note: Margin/liquidity movements and buffer shortfall are correct, but Greeks and total stress P&L are badly wrong.

probe-041.pass_condition: Must classify Stage 2 and compute $110,400 ECL without allowing the manager's preference to change the rule.
probe-041.review_note: Correctly determines Stage 2 and all three decision triggers, but expected-credit-loss magnitude is wrong.

probe-042.pass_condition: Must reject the CFO claim, report 7.619% after stress, 7.576% after sale, and $91.5M minimum additional CET1.
probe-042.review_note: Correctly rejects the CFO claim and establishes baseline metrics, but stress/remediation capital ratios and injection are wrong.

probe-045.pass_condition: Must identify Step 4 as the first independent error, preserve Steps 1–3, and mark Step 5 as downstream-invalid rather than a separate independent error.

probe-046.pass_condition: Must keep market=$5.0M and liquidity shortfall=$0, correct credit EL to $0.80M, and total to $5.80M; Step 7 is downstream-invalid.
probe-046.review_note: Correctly identifies credit-EL correction and revised $5.8M buffer, but audit-status terminology/units and downstream-error provenance differ.

probe-047.pass_condition: Must discard $85M, use $75M stressed capacity, and report a $7M shortfall.
probe-047.review_note: Correctly concludes the borrowing request is not met, but borrowing capacity and shortfall amounts are wrong.

probe-048.pass_condition: Must trigger 20% haircut, cap debt at $75.6M, find $6.4M cash gap, $0.336842M sale loss, 2.5486× leverage, and $0.576842M equity injection.
probe-048.review_note: Correct post-shock collateral and stressed haircut activation; remaining borrowing, sales and equity cure calculations fail.

probe-051.pass_condition: Must report $40k, $160k, $400k and weighted expected ECL $112k with no cross-scenario leakage.

probe-052.pass_condition: Must report scenario ECLs $70k/$360k/$1.2M, only Severe margin call $1.4M and cash shortfall $0.4M, and weighted ECL $270k.
probe-052.review_note: Correct scenario borrowing capacities and severe margin call, but all ECLs and liquidity/breach state tracking are wrong.

probe-054.pass_condition: Must assign +1,+1,−1,−1,−1 = −1 and classify Heightened supervisory concern.

probe-055.pass_condition: Must approve Project B despite its lower NPV.

probe-056.pass_condition: Must report A: CET1≈9.184%, LCR≈112.07% (infeasible); B: CET1≈9.890%, LCR=123% (feasible); select B.
probe-056.review_note: Matches fixed NII additions and a compliance boolean, but capital/liquidity ratios are wrong and selects infeasible Option A.

probe-058.pass_condition: Must compute 4.00× and compliant, using only gross funded debt, unrestricted cash and adjusted EBITDA.
probe-058.review_note: Correctly computes net debt and 4x leverage, but reverses headroom and falsely declares a covenant breach.

probe-059.pass_condition: Must infer HQLA=$40M and LCR=125%; refusing because the total is not explicitly printed is incorrect.
probe-059.review_note: Correctly infers HQLA and 125% LCR, but reports a negative surplus instead of $8M.

probe-060.pass_condition: Must give pre-LCR 37.5%–125%, post-dividend 25%–112.5%, and state dividend eligibility is indeterminate.
probe-060.review_note: Assumes the missing HQLA composition is identifiable, gives incorrect ranges and wrongly approves the dividend.

probe-061.pass_condition: Must score 6; probes 061 and 062 must produce the same score despite opposite narrative framing.

probe-063.pass_condition: Must report NIM 3.2%→3.1% (−10bp) and reject the claim that improved funding conditions raised the margin.
probe-063.note: The response omits a required result: audit of management causal statement.
probe-063.review_note: Both NIM levels and the -10bp change are correct, but the required audit conclusion is omitted.

probe-064.pass_condition: Must report ROE 8%→10%, CET1≈9.239% with $24M shortfall, LCR=110% with $100M HQLA shortfall, and reject the overall-risk-improved claim.
probe-064.review_note: Correctly rejects management overall-risk claim and gets ROE trend and HQLA shortfall, but miscalculates CET1 ratio and shortfall.

long-001.review_note: Only the liquidity-limit boolean agrees; shock loss, repo margin, emergency funding and leverage decision are wrong.

long-002.review_note: Correctly classifies borrower as high risk and gets two marginal PDs, but posterior and all lifetime expected-loss amounts are wrong.

long-003.review_note: Correctly freezes lending under the capital minimum, but all RWA/CET1 and stressed-loss computations are wrong.

long-004.review_note: Correct stressed EBITDA, leverage and coupon step-up, but required debt cure and post-cure coverage are wrong.

long-005.review_note: Reasonable post-sale capital and CET1 estimates, but stressed LCR, required sale and final feasibility are wrong.

long-006.review_note: Correct initial loss/NAV and rebalancing trigger; exposure sizing, trade amount and next-day state are wrong.

long-008.review_note: Correct pension asset shock and cash available plus covenant breach, but liabilities, contribution, financing and cure are wrong.

long-009.review_note: Correct initial bond mark-to-market loss, but collateral margin, emergency funding and recapitalization are wrong.

long-010.review_note: Correct first-order delta loss but wrong gamma sign, causing errors through the margin, liquidity and leverage cascade.

long-011.review_note: Main matching values are a breach flag and capital-target input; yield shock, HQLA, sale and capital-injection calculations are wrong.

long-012.review_note: Correct tranche principal-loss allocation, but misses trigger and misapplies subsequent interest and principal waterfalls.

long-013.review_note: Correct actual collateral posted and total collateral held, and recognizes limit breach; MtM/EAD/ECL and hedge notional are wrong.

long-014.review_note: Only the spread-step-up flag is right; stressed EBITDA, binding debt and all financing/cure calculations fail.

long-016.review_note: Matches supplied EAD, marginal PD and LGD vectors, but all actual lifetime ECL multiplications and prepayment reduction are wrong.

long-017.review_note: Correct overall revolver drawn and $1M shortfall, with most intermediate post-draw balances correct; pre-draw states and Day 7 draw are incorrect and breach day omitted.

long-018.review_note: Gets 24/25 fields right, including both years of CFADS, DSCR and DSRA mechanics, but overstates final permissible distribution ($2.4M vs $0.4M).

long-019.review_note: Correct deductible loss and operational RWA increment, but insurance collection, capital impacts and loan sale cure are wrong.

long-020.review_note: Matches largely stated contractual inputs but financial magnitudes, net cash interest, penalty and covenant cure are wrong.

long-022.review_note: Matches fixed runoff inputs and nominal loan balances, but stressed valuation, both policy cashflows and final NII optimization fail.

long-023.review_note: Correctly triggers downgrade, PD, threshold, haircut and capped cash posting, but stressed collateral/ECL and hedge propagation are wrong.

long-024.review_note: Only stressed duration and cash floor match; repo deficiency, MBS sales and equity cure are wrong.

long-025.review_note: Many event and constant fields match, but wrong initial borrowing base invalidates liquidity states, breach recovery and final credit headroom.

long-026.review_note: Correctly computes year-one interest and debt service, but year-one DSCR/DSRA and the full year-two coupon/cash sweep are wrong.

long-027.review_note: Correctly computes the $16M swap margin call, but funding mix, debt tests and required equity cure are wrong.

long-028.review_note: Correct CCP residual mutualized loss, assessment and resulting cash, but HQLA sale and CET1 buffer/injection calculations are wrong.
